title: Prove portable guidance without copying private operations
text: Public product teaching now has nested canonical homes under docs/public, including one agent rules file with Claude-only steps beside it, machine authorization, GitHub scope, shared files and verification. The rules file and canonical homes explicitly cover modular durable design, maintained dependency reuse, truthful failure evidence, disposable telemetry, declared infrastructure recovery, capability-specific harness deferral and visual proof. These source statements do not prove actual before-action delivery or completed private extraction. The source-only teaching model stays outside the install bundle. Installed agents, skills and agent rules carry no Yoke source-development steps; Yoke self-deploy, serving-floor and refusal-helper rules live in docs/source-dev-doctrine.md. Private topology, operator state, fresh private pointer inventory and rollback evidence remain private and unproved here. Global hook orientation, user-level yoke-global appearance, combined global sizing and actual global receiving captures moved to YOK-3975 and remain required there. No private source absence or ownership transfer counts as successful delivery.
owner: Yoke public guidance; private operations owner; YOK-3975 global delivery
